page.overview:
What is Balloon Animatronics?

The Balloon animatronics are a set of animatronic counterparts seemingly themed off of Balloon Boy, and exclusively appeared as marketable Five Nights at Freddy's products since their debut in Fall 2022 by Seven Times Six.

Balloon Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart with a red and blue-colored propeller hat and shirt, blue pants and is holding a blue balloon. He is available as a plush toy, figure, and Funko POP!

Balloon Bonnie is Bonnie the Rabbit's counterpart with a pink and red-colored propeller hat and shirt, blue pants, and is holding a pink balloon. He is available as a figure and Funko POP!

Balloon Chica is Chica the Chicken's counterpart with a purple and red-colored propeller hat and shirt, blue pants, and is holding a purple balloon. She is available as a figure and Funko POP!
